Jordan / Lindsey — thanks again for a focused discovery this morning. Quick recap and a concrete next step to keep momentum: I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures the milestones we discussed and a proposed target close.

High-level proposal
- Target close (contract signed): 2026-11-18 (two-week runway)
- Procurement signature deadline (internal procurement must approve & sign): 2026-11-16
- Key milestones and owners in attached MAP (spreadsheet):
  - PO issued / legal review kickoff — owner: Jordan (AcmeOps) — target 2026-11-09
  - SOW review / redlines — owner: Ben Carter (Redwood) — target 2026-11-12
  - Security questionnaire evidence handoff — owner: Priyom Das (Redwood) — target 2026-11-10
  - Contract signature (DocuSign) — owner: AcmeOps procurement — target 2026-11-16

As discussed, the two places we can compress are the SOW review and legal turnaround if AcmeOps can commit to a firm signature deadline. Please confirm if the 11/16 procurement sign-off is feasible on your side — if not, tell us the latest procurement cutover you need and we’ll adjust the MAP.

Action items for this thread
- Jordan: confirm procurement constraints and internal approvers (who signs)
- Lindsey / procurement: confirm whether 11-16 is achievable or give alternate cutoff
- Ben / Priyom: we'll prepare final SOW + redline-ready doc by 11-10 if procurement confirms

Attachments: AcmeOps_MAP_v0.9.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF - draft)

Thanks — I’ll put a short version of the MAP into Drive and share link after your confirmation.

Best,
Irene

Thanks, Irene — helpful recap. Quick answers from my side:
- I am the deal owner internally and will shepherd approvals but procurement owns the signature.
- Procurement deadline: our finance & procurement leadership has a weekly cutover on Mondays. To get onto the 11/16 signature window we need legal sign-off completed by 11/12 EOD so procurement can route for approval.
- Primary signer is Theresa Kim (SVP Finance) — I’ll loop her if we confirm this week.

I’ve copied procurement for visibility — Lindsey / procurement team, any red flags with the timeline above? If you need more runway, tell us the latest dates and we’ll rebaseline.

Also, a FYI — we have a compliance micro-review that could add 1 business day if the security pack requires evidence beyond standard SOC2 artifacts. Priyom / Redwood, can you confirm the security artifacts you’ll hand over so we can triage that risk?
